point_proof: Exactly one structurally decoded TCP/UDP packet at the exact label timestamp and bidirectional tuple, with matching directional packet count and IP bytes. Missing-duration labels must declare one packet; zero/multiple/unknown counts are excluded. Reject packet claims shared by multiple UIDs, including known-duration claims.
candidate_flow_rule: Resolve only proven missing ends to their witnessed instant. Point matches additionally require a one-packet, zero-duration NFStream flow with the same direction, IP-byte count and quantized timestamp. All other missing ends remain blockers; the original interval rule is preserved for known ends.
acceptance: Preserve every previous accepted v1 match; replay saved v1 aggregate counts and assignment digest. Report per-detail coverage and packet-structure failures. Support/coverage gains are not detection metrics or training authorization. Resource screen: sampled RSS tree sum <1 GiB, wall <600 seconds/capture excluding downloads.
parser_scope: Classic PCAP Ethernet, micro/nanosecond timestamps, IPv4/IPv6 base headers, up to two VLAN tags, TCP/UDP header structure. Fragments, IPv6 extensions, other transport protocols and unsupported links remain explicit. No checksum validation, reassembly, payload inspection, transmission or live capture.
